verdict.rationale: Warp's automation platform (Triggers, Schedules, Warp Drive workflows) includes some observability — 'every run is tracked, auditable, and shareable' — which covers a review aspect, but there is no documented versioning system or rollback mechanism for automations. Missing for 10: version history/diffing of automation definitions, explicit rollback/revert capability, and any workflow approval process beyond basic run tracking.
